+_CLIXML_HEADER = re.compile(rb'(?:#< |<# )CLIXML\r\n|(?m:^CLIXML\r\n)')
+_CLIXML_END = b'</Objs>'
+
+
+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks embedded in stderr with their text."""
+    if b'CLIXML\r\n' not in stderr:
+        return stderr
+
+    output = []
+    offset = 0
+    search_from = 0
+
+    while True:
+        header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, search_from)
+        if header is None:
+            output.append(stderr[offset:])
+            break
+
+        header_start = header.start()
+        xml_start = stderr.find(b'<Objs ', header.end())
+        if xml_start == -1:
+            next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, header.end())
+            if next_header is None:
+                output.append(stderr[offset:])
+                break
+
+            # Leave an incomplete sequence intact, but continue looking for a
+            # later complete block.
+            output.append(stderr[offset:next_header.start()])
+            offset = next_header.start()
+            search_from = next_header.start()
+            continue
+
+        end_start = stderr.find(_CLIXML_END, xml_start)
+        if end_start == -1:
+            next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, header.end())
+            if next_header is None:
+                output.append(stderr[offset:])
+                break
+
+            # Do not let an incomplete block consume a subsequent one.
+            output.append(stderr[offset:next_header.start()])
+            offset = next_header.start()
+            search_from = next_header.start()
+            continue
+
+        # A later header before this root closes means the current sequence is
+        # incomplete. Keep it intact and give the later sequence its own pass.
+        next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, xml_start, end_start)
+        if next_header is not None:
+            output.append(stderr[offset:next_header.start()])
+            offset = next_header.start()
+            search_from = next_header.start()
+            continue
+
+        block_end = end_start + len(_CLIXML_END)
+
+        # A stream can contain consecutive serialized roots, sometimes with
+        # another CLIXML header between them. Keep those together so the
+        # existing parser can separate their messages correctly.
+        while True:
+            next_xml = stderr.find(b'<Objs ', block_end)
+            if next_xml == -1:
+                break
+
+            separator = stderr[block_end:next_xml]
+            for nested_header in (b'#< CLIXML\r\n', b'<# CLIXML\r\n', b'CLIXML\r\n'):
+                separator = separator.replace(nested_header, b'')
+            if separator.strip(b' \t\r\n'):
+                break
+
+            next_end_start = stderr.find(_CLIXML_END, next_xml)
+            if next_end_start == -1:
+                break
+            block_end = next_end_start + len(_CLIXML_END)
+
+        block = stderr[header_start:block_end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                normalized_block = block.decode('utf-8').encode('utf-8')
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                normalized_block = block.decode('cp437').encode('utf-8')
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(normalized_block)
+        except Exception:
+            # Malformed XML and invalid CLIXML escape sequences should remain
+            # visible exactly as they arrived.
+            output.append(stderr[offset:block_end])
+        else:
+            output.append(stderr[offset:header_start])
+            output.append(decoded)
+
+        offset = block_end
+        search_from = block_end
+
+    return b''.join(output)
+
